items.title: 68728_Jonah
items.q: We brought in this guy I was telling you about, John L. Henderson, on alto sax, and Joe Thomas, that used to play sax with Jimmy Lunceford.

ctx.x: You blew it shooting pool. They had a poolroom that stayed open all night. We were playing nine ball for $10.00 a game. And then finally we enlarged the band. We brought in this guy I was telling you about, John L. Henderson, on alto sax, and Joe Thomas, that used to play sax with Jimmy Lunceford.
